assertions.name: bring_discriminant_at_alpha_1
assertions.source: Δ_Bring(α=1) = 256·5^5 + 3125·1^4 = 800000 + 3125 = 803125. Non-zero ⇒ non-degenerate quintic ⇒ Hermite resolvent applies.

description: GAP-A-4 T14 — q-Hermite icosahedral resolvent candidate.  Inherits T13's cusp divergence obstruction (Δ_modular built from E_4, E_6 which diverge at q = 1).  REFUTED at expansion-point level.  8th candidate cross-algebra functor refuted in the T4-T14 arc.

q_hermite_obstruction.inheritance_chain: q-Hermite resolvent built from Klein invariants (T11) + modular discriminant Δ(q) = (E_4^3 − E_6^2)/1728 (T13). Δ inherits T13's cusp divergence ⇒ q-Hermite inherits it too.
q_hermite_obstruction.verdict: q-Hermite resolvent candidate REFUTED at expansion-point level. 8th candidate cross-algebra functor refuted (after T5×3, T7, T8, T10, T13). The h⁴ obstruction stays structurally OPEN.
q_hermite_obstruction.structural_conclusion: All q-modular / icosahedral-algebraic routes that pull back through q = 1 as the h = 0 base point share the same cusp obstruction.  The Borromean h⁴ = −3/4 is a polynomial coefficient, NOT a transcendental q-series coefficient, so the q-modular-form direction is structurally mismatched.

data.synthesis_verdict: T14 refutes the q-Hermite icosahedral resolvent candidate cross-algebra functor at the expansion-point level.  The Hermite resolvent is built from the Klein invariants (T11) AND the modular discriminant Δ(q) = (E_4^3 − E_6^2)/1728 — which T13 showed diverges at q = 1 (the natural h = 0 base point).  Therefore the q-Hermite resolvent inherits T13's cusp obstruction.  Classical sanity verified: at α = 1, the real root of y^5 + 5y + 1 is computed to 40-digit precision and the Bring discriminant Δ = 803125 ≠ 0 confirms non-degeneracy.  8th candidate cross-algebra functor refuted (after T5×3, T7, T8, T10, T13).  STRUCTURAL CONCLUSION: all q-modular / icosahedral-algebraic routes that pull back through q = 1 as the h = 0 base point share the same cusp obstruction.  The Borromean h⁴ = −3/4 is a POLYNOMIAL coefficient — NOT a transcendental q-series coefficient — so the entire q-modular-form direction is STRUCTURALLY MISMATCHED to the h⁴ obstruction.  The remaining open directions point AWAY from q-modular forms entirely (e.g. Bring quintic discriminant locus as a non-modular algebraic variety; or a genuinely new mechanism linking the polynomial reference to a different categorical object).
